shots.text: Every land we had freed sent its fighters to Solenne: Emberfolk smiths, Galeborn riders, Deepwood archers, Tidefolk, Stoneborn and Veilwalkers.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Wide shot of Solenne crammed with every people of the Ring, each lighting a small light in its own colour. The city glows like a lantern in the black.

shots.text: Cassivane came for the Heartstone himself. He had fused the pieces of the Sunstone into his own body. We called what he had become the Sundered Heart.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: On the dark plain, in the centre of the horde, a vast floating knot of shattered light with a man's shape inside: the Sundered Heart.

shots.text:
If he takes the Heartstone, the Gate opens all the way and Vael-Orrun walks out. So he does not take it.

Hold this wall.
shots.speaker: ysolde
shots.art_note: Ysolde on the inner wall, blindfolded, Tamsin at her arm, the heroes along the battlements.

shots.text: ...There's a light on the east road. Does nobody else see it?
shots.speaker: ysolde
shots.art_note: Ysolde turning her blind face east. Tamsin looks: nothing but darkness.
